verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers digital tools through LathamDrive, including a legal document generator, the Automated Convertible Note generator, and the Book of Jargon apps. A built-in AI assistant is therefore a fair question for this product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one; the tools shown are template-based generators and glossaries.
